purpose: Inventory the completed DT-001 through DT-010 Developer Toolbelt and the AIOC control/evidence surfaces that a future Developer Console may present or invoke without becoming a new authority source.

toolbelt.title: Developer Toolbelt Foundation / Doctor
toolbelt.console_rule: May display and refresh doctor observations. WARN must not be presented as BLOCK, and a doctor PASS is not work-item completion.

toolbelt.title: STAGE-A-A2 Preflight / Compatibility Mapper
toolbelt.console_rule: May show compatibility and stop-condition state. It must not activate A2, create its branch, install dependencies, or convert preliminary target roots into exact changed-path authority.

toolbelt.title: Codex Task Capsule Builder
toolbelt.console_rule: Generated capsules are execution aids, not governance authority. READY_TO_EXECUTE requires the governed branch, a nonblocking preflight, and exact changed-path authority; write/force actions must be explicit.

toolbelt.title: Fixture Gateway
toolbelt.console_rule: Must preserve canonical, synthetic_qa, campaign_local, and source_only classes. Projection authorization occurs before counts/records/fields; projection stays authoritative=false.

toolbelt.title: Deterministic Scenario / E2E Runner
toolbelt.console_rule: The built-in fixture-gateway adapter is read-only. Authoritative mutation requirements BLOCK until an owning-domain application/service adapter exists; the console must not simulate success by editing fixture state.

toolbelt.title: Permission Leak Scanner
toolbelt.console_rule: Any finding is blocking for the supplied scan surface, but PASS is not a production security certification and the scanner does not invent a role hierarchy.

toolbelt.title: UI Evidence Harvester
toolbelt.console_rule: Synthetic CI PNGs are tool tests, not product UI evidence. A receipt is valid only for its exact candidate SHA and required attestations.

toolbelt.title: Design-System Compliance Linter
toolbelt.console_rule: Legacy findings remain visible as WARN; newly added violations BLOCK. The console must not imply static lint proves semantic accessibility, privacy, focus behavior, contrast, responsive quality, or screenshot conformance.

toolbelt.title: Traceability Compiler
toolbelt.console_rule: Text mention is never proof. PROVEN requires explicit structured PASS/COMPLETE proof links with exact candidate identity, and evidence proof also requires an evidence digest. PROVEN does not independently close a work item.

toolbelt.title: Recovery / Performance Harness
toolbelt.console_rule: Reference probes are not product recovery proof. Numerical budgets require an explicit approved budget_source; tool/CI timing must not become a product target by implication.

aioc_control_surfaces.authority: selected conversational execution pointer; not completion evidence by itself
aioc_control_surfaces.console_use: primary work/slice header, parallel attempts, deferred tracks, selection provenance

aioc_control_surfaces.authority: recovery boundary for exact active substep, branch, completion gate, blockers and validation state
aioc_control_surfaces.console_use: scope, stop state, completion gate, next action, immutable evidence references

aioc_control_surfaces.authority: derived compact projection; must match pointer/checkpoint
aioc_control_surfaces.console_use: fast status card only; never overrides source checkpoint
program position and tranche completion status
governing-source navigation; do not treat as an activity log

aioc_control_surfaces.authority: repository-first recovery, checkpoint cadence, final-gate validation and evidence-before-claim rules
aioc_control_surfaces.console_use: explain why an action is observation-only, owner-gated, blocked, ready-for-review or completed_verified

aioc_control_surfaces.authority: historical deterministic control-health result for its recorded pilot; not live work-state
aioc_control_surfaces.console_use: control-health panel with recorded run scope and explicit unmeasured longitudinal metrics

aioc_control_surfaces.authority: mechanical pointer/checkpoint/status consistency and evidence-kind validation
aioc_control_surfaces.console_use: interruption recovery diagnostics and state-integrity checks
diagnostic history; a record becomes a current blocker only when bound to the active attempt/current required gate

aioc_control_surfaces.authority: canonical repository evidence for candidate identity, review/merge state, hosted validation and signature verification
aioc_control_surfaces.console_use: CI/evidence receipts, exact-head gate, mergeability and completion evidence
